name: Demo E3: Modeled Duct Size Transition Redline
description: Run a bounded modeled duct size-transition redline through /revit/reroute-mep-route-segment and require model write evidence, size readback, connector/fitting audit, visual gate, and cleanup evidence.
setup_instructions: Open the target Revit model and the sheet/view containing the duct size redline.
Use a prepared deterministic request with a verified host duct id and transition point projected onto that duct.
Use /revit/reroute-mep-route-segment with operation=size_transition, apply=true, verify=true, and visualVerify=true; do not report completion from a dry-run.
success_criteria: The result reports created, modified, or fitting model ids for the duct transition.
The projected transition point is reported and matches the requested point within tolerance.
Requested upstream/downstream duct sizes are read back after the model write.
A fitting id or connector-network audit is reported.
A focused post-change capture is returned and the redline visual gate passes.
Created disposable segment/fitting ids are proven in a cleanup dry-run and then deleted after verification evidence is recorded.
failure_criteria: The workflow only dry-runs or returns no model write ids.
The projected transition point is missing or off target.
The requested size readback is missing or mismatched.
No fitting/readback or connector-network audit is reported.
The focused visual capture is missing.
The redline visual gate is fail or uncertain.
Cleanup is requested but created transition ids are missing from cleanup evidence.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers one safe duct size-transition case first. It is not yet pipe coverage and is not satisfied by changing annotation/tag text without model write evidence.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete created transition/fitting ids after visual verification so repeated live reliability runs do not accumulate model clutter.
